annotations.title: Check a payment before money moves

description: Call before releasing ANY payment, whether an AI agent or a payment system is sending it. One call checks the agent's authority (Mandate Chain, Agent Passport or Spend Gate token), the payee's sealed bank details (Payment Notary), the human kill switch (Jugular) and every FCA-named fraud indicator, then answers RELEASE, HOLD or STOP with the reasons, sealed. Release money only on RELEASE. The answer lists the next tools to call. Needs api_key; never send names or account numbers.

audience.description: the site an Agent Passport is presented at

jugular_id.description: the Jugular kill switch held over this fraud engine

lineage_id.description: Model Lineage code of the scoring model setup

mandate.description: Mandate Chain token when an AI agent started the payment

passport.description: Agent Passport token when an AI agent started the payment

payee_fingerprint.description: sha256 hex of payment:v1|<business name, trimmed, lower case>|<sort code digits>|<account digits>, checked against the Payment Notary

payer_ref.description: who is paying (your reference); defaults to agent-payments

spend_token.description: Spend Gate token when an AI agent started the payment
